state_transport.content: byte-identical to the P1 model input: compact_state_v1.yaml model_input_preamble.strip() + '\n\n' + frozen compact_states/ITEM_XX.json bytes (canonical JSON). The compact JSON bytes are embedded unchanged.
state_transport.reason: P1 sent exactly this text as Decisions API input; same bytes keep the observation information identical

retry_policy: network/timeout errors, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, and Cloudflare temporary-capacity errors only; exponential backoff 1s*2^n + U(0,0.25)s jitter; 400/401/403/404/422 and invalid request schema never retried

adapter.source: experiments/p1_decisions/src/decision_adapter.py loaded unchanged from its frozen bytes (hash checked against p1_freeze.json); thresholds, confidence formula, priority weights, tie-break and event_type map read from the frozen P1 decisions_questions_v1.json 'adapter' block
adapter.prediction_templates: experiments/p1_decisions/src/prediction_adapter.py loaded from its frozen bytes with provider-name string substitutions only (see src/prediction_adapter.py PROVIDER_SUBSTITUTIONS); evidence/uncertainty/temporal templates unchanged
adapter.category_reconciliation: none (same as P1-v1: is_incident from p(incident) and event_type from the category answer are independent; known is_incident=false + category mismatch is NOT fixed here; deferred to common-adapter-v2 for both models)

pricing.billing_rule: input tokens only (no output-token price listed for Clef models)
pricing.pricing_source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/ ('Other model pricing': @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash $0.090 per M input tokens / 8182 neurons per M input tokens); live cross-check: GET /accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/models/search catalog property price=0.09 USD per M input tokens (logs/cloudflare_schema_snapshot.json)
